text: Chapter 6 (Twenty 3-Part Chords You Should Know) is a notation-heavy reference chapter cataloging essential 3-part chord voicings. The chapter is predominantly tablature/notation tables without prose teaching content, so no load-bearing prose passages were extracted. Its function in the volume is to provide a complete reference repertoire of essential 3-part chord voicings that the student is expected to internalize as the foundation for the subsequent 840-chord catalog.
